name: 蒂姆·伯纳斯-李
bio_short: 英国计算机科学家，万维网（World Wide Web）的发明者。他在1989年提出了万维网的构想（`berners_lee_www_1989`），发明了HTTP、HTML和URL，并编写了世界上第一个网页浏览器。他坚持将万维网技术无偿向全世界开放，彻底改变了人类分享信息的方式。
bio_short_en: A British computer scientist and the inventor of the World Wide Web. He proposed the concept of the Web in 1989 (`berners_lee_www_1989`), inventing HTTP, HTML, and URLs, and wrote the first web browser. He insisted on making Web technology freely available to the world, fundamentally changing how humanity shares information.
